_meta.definition: The unifying capability across all tables is the management of orders, including customer history tracking, order line item management, and order processing.

cust_hist._description: Tracks historical customer purchases, linking each transaction to a specific customer and product.

columns.name: customerid
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the customer entity

columns.name: orderid
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the order entity

columns.name: prod_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the prod_ entity

orderlines._description: Tracks individual product quantities and associated orders in the DellStore2 sales process.

columns.name: orderlineid
columns.description: Primary key uniquely identifying each row in orderlines

columns.name: orderid
columns.description: Primary key uniquely identifying each row in orderlines

columns.name: prod_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the prod_ entity

columns.name: quantity
columns.description: Stores the number of items for each product line in an order.

columns.name: orderdate
columns.description: Stores the date format of order placement (YYYY-MM-DD) in a consistent manner.

orders._description: Tracks details of individual customer orders and their associated financial information in DellStore2.

columns.name: orderid
columns.description: Primary key uniquely identifying each row in orders

columns.name: orderdate
columns.description: Stores formatted date strings for order placement in YYYY-MM-DD format.

columns.name: customerid
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the customer entity

columns.name: netamount
columns.description: Stores the total floating-point value of items ordered in each transaction.

columns.name: tax
columns.description: Stores floating-point values representing taxes for individual orders.

columns.name: totalamount
columns.description: Stores the total monetary value (in decimal format) for each order.

_meta.definition: The process of managing and maintaining product information, including categories and details, across the enterprise system.

categories._description: Categorizes product offerings in DellStore2 for user-friendly navigation.

columns.name: category
columns.description: Stores category identifiers (1, 2, 3, 4, 5) for various product categories in DellStore2 database.

columns.name: categoryname
columns.description: Stores up to 50 characters of movie genre names such as Action, Animation, Children, Classics, and Comedy.

products._description: Captures details of various products offered in DellStore2, including their categories, titles, actors, prices, special offers, and common identifiers.

columns.name: prod_id
columns.description: Primary key uniquely identifying each row in products

columns.name: category
columns.description: Stores product category identifiers, such as 14 for computers, 6 for monitors, and 3 for printers.

columns.name: title
columns.description: Stores up to 50 characters of product titles for the Academy series.

columns.name: actor
columns.description: Stores actor names for products.

columns.name: price
columns.description: Stores product prices as decimal amounts.

columns.name: special
columns.description: Stores a boolean value indicating if a product has special offers.

columns.name: common_prod_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the common_prod_ entity

_meta.definition: The process of managing inventory levels, reordering products, and tracking order-related data.

inventory._description: Tracks inventory levels of products in stock and sales transactions.

columns.name: prod_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the prod_ entity

columns.name: quan_in_stock
columns.description: Stores the quantity of items currently in stock.

columns.name: sales
columns.description: Stores the number of sales transactions for each inventory item.

reorder._description: Tracks product reordering details, including ID, low stock date, minimum quantity, reorder date, and expected delivery date.

columns.name: prod_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the prod_ entity

columns.name: date_low
columns.description: Stores formatted dates for low reorder points.

columns.name: quan_low
columns.description: Stocks to reorder when quantity drops below a certain level (e.g., 12, 8, 15, 10, 6).

columns.name: date_reordered
columns.description: Stores formatted date of product reorders as YYYY-MM-DD strings.

columns.name: quan_reordered
columns.description: Stores the quantity of items reordered in individual transactions.

columns.name: date_expected
columns.description: Stores expected reorder dates in YYYY-MM-DD format.

_meta.definition: The process of managing and maintaining customer profiles, including personal information, account details, and purchasing history.

customers._description: Captures customer details including personal information, contact data, and financial information for managing online sales at DellStore2.

columns.name: customerid
columns.description: Primary key uniquely identifying each row in customers

columns.name: firstname
columns.description: Stores customer names, represented as alphanumeric strings of up to 10 characters.

columns.name: lastname
columns.description: Stores customer surnames up to 10 characters long.

columns.name: address1
columns.description: Stores detailed street addresses of customers at Dell Way.

columns.name: address2
columns.description: Stores additional customer address information (if provided).

columns.name: city
columns.description: Stores city names up to 10 characters long, possibly abbreviated.

columns.name: state
columns.description: Stores two-letter abbreviations for U.S. states of customers.

columns.name: zip
columns.description: Stores 5-digit postal codes for customers.

columns.name: country
columns.description: Stores customer countries as 50 character VARCHARs, with all provided examples being American (USA).

columns.name: region
columns.description: Stores customer region IDs, all set to 1 in these samples.

columns.name: email
columns.description: Stores unique email addresses of Dell customers.

columns.name: phone
columns.description: Stores customer phone numbers as 10-digit integers.

columns.name: creditcardtype
columns.description: Stores customer credit card type identifiers (1: Visa, 4: Mastercard, 5: Amex, 3: Discover)

columns.name: creditcard
columns.description: Stores 15-digit customer credit card numbers.

columns.name: creditcardexpiration
columns.description: Stores credit card expiration dates in YYYY/MM format.

columns.name: username
columns.description: Stores usernames up to 10 characters for customer accounts.

columns.name: "password"
columns.description: Stores encrypted customer passwords of maximum 10 characters.

columns.name: age
columns.description: Stores customer ages as integers, ranging from 21 to 80 years.

columns.name: income
columns.description: Stores customer's annual income as integer values, typically in thousands of dollars.

columns.name: gender
columns.description: Stores customer gender data as either 'M' for male or 'F' for female (up to 10 characters).
